scenario: A permission is declared in the manifest but no other artifact references its use.

supported_findings: The manifest declares RECORD_AUDIO, but no string, component name, or log entry in this case's artifacts references audio recording, playback, or any recording-related function.
The visible strings (memo_list_view, memo_delete, app_settings_screen) describe list-management and settings functionality, not recording activity itself.
This is a declared-but-unevidenced-use pattern -- the permission exists, but this case's evidence does not show it exercised or referenced elsewhere.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that audio was recorded or that the RECORD_AUDIO permission was exercised -- no artifact in this case supports that beyond the bare manifest declaration.
Any claim that this is necessarily suspicious -- a memo app plausibly uses RECORD_AUDIO even if this particular artifact extraction didn't capture corroborating strings.
known_contradictions: manifest declares RECORD_AUDIO; no other artifact (strings, components, traffic_log) references any audio-recording functionality.
